mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, increasing the probability of a recession and triggering risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month for two consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressures that may trigger future rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a falling industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
